content:
alana-cs: FYI ticket #52612 — customer reports SCIM deprovision not removing users when Okta group is removed. they say role stays assigned even after group disappears. https://support.redwood.example/t/52612

michael-customer: seeing this in prod after an Okta group rename + downstream group removal. users left in role but no group membership. 3 customers hit it so far.

alana-cs: can you paste the SCIM PATCH payload Okta sent and a failing user id? also include any error from our provisioning logs.

michael-customer: here is the PATCH Okta sent (trimmed):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "replace",
    "path": "members",
    "value": [
      {"value":"00u1abcdEFG2hI3Jk4l5","display":"alice"},
      {"value":"00u1mnopQRs2tU3Vw4x5","display":"bob"} 
    ]
  }]
}
```
and the group object had externalId: "oktagrp/00g6ZxYz". failing user id: 00u1abcdEFG2hI3Jk4l5.

provisioning-bot: job 2023-11-02T14:02:11Z ERROR: group lookup by external_id "oktagrp/00g6ZxYz" did not match any role mapping. skipping deprovision for 12 members.

sanjay-eng: I think root cause is externalId normalization. our role-mapper expects externalId == plain group id (00g6ZxYz) but Okta prefixes with `oktagrp/`. also Okta is sending members as user refs (value=userId) which is fine. mapping layer didn't strip prefix so no role match on delete -> orphaned role.

olivia-ops: is it safe to change normalization to strip leading `okta*` prefixes? any risk for other identity providers?

sanjay-eng: yes safe. plan: add normalizer that strips leading `^okta[^/]*\/` and leading `group:` variants, then re-run reconcile. quick patch (postgres) we used in staging: 
```sql
UPDATE role_mappings
SET normalized_external_id = regexp_replace(external_id, '^.*?(?:oktagrp\/|okta:|group:)', '')
WHERE normalized_external_id IS NULL OR normalized_external_id != regexp_replace(external_id, '^.*?(?:oktagrp\/|okta:|group:)', '');
```
That updates mapping table only; runtime will also apply same rule for incoming SCIM ops.

alana-cs: temporary workaround while we patch: admin -> role mappings -> add mapping for the exact externalId "oktagrp/00g6ZxYz" to the affected role. does customer want us to do that?

michael-customer: yes please, can you add it for the four affected roles? would help us unblock until you push.

sanjay-eng: will add mapping and deploy normalizer. also schedule a backfill to remove orphaned role assignments created after 2023-10-30. need a 1-hour maintenance window.

kevin-ml: will backfill impact analytics / billing? need to ensure we only touch role assignments, not tokens.

sanjay-eng: backfill only updates user-role link table (no token revokes). we will not touch API keys. ops will snapshot before run.

provisioning-bot: action: created manual mapping entries for: "oktagrp/00g6ZxYz" -> role id r_12, "oktagrp/00g7AbCd" -> r_17, "oktagrp/00g9EfGh" -> r_19, "oktagrp/00g0IjKl" -> r_21.

alana-cs: deployed the normalizer to prod at 2023-11-02T15:10Z, scheduled backfill at 2023-11-02T16:00Z. notified customer.

michael-customer: verified 2 users were removed from the orphaned role after the mapping add. will watch for a few hours and report back. thanks all :pray:

alana-cs: great — leaving this thread open until backfill completes and customer confirms. tagging @sanjay-eng and @olivia-ops for post-run checks. :white_check_mark:
